Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €6.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.
A few words on this from our side.
Extending the payment terms to 90 days would significantly increase our financing costs.
If we maintain our standard 30 days net payment terms, we are able to offer a reduced price of €6.00 per unit.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your continued partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always value working with you and supporting your requirements with our extensive inventory and reliable distributor service.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot features a price of €6.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

In addition, we have an alternative package available for you. By returning to our standard 30-day payment terms, we can offer you a unit price of €6.00. This option at our standard terms includes a price of €6.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel.

Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days. We look forward to your decision and to continuing our strong business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
